messages:
jon_sales: Quick check-in 7 Prospect 'MercuryPay' asked if 9 reserved GPUs + burst to 18 + KV warmup is a safe starting point. Profile: peak ~500 qps mixed chat+embed, chat avg ~52 tokens, p95 tokens ~250. They need p95 chat <350ms and want KMS + request-audit answers.

priya_ops: Short answer: 9 reserved is tight if KV miss rate is high. With aggressive KV warmup (top 7k prefixes) and batching we can make it reasonable. Recommend reserve=9, autoscale max=18, max_burst=9, az_strategy=2-way. Add canary and fallback to smaller model on eviction.

marc_ml: Throughput notes: for a quantized 70B-class model with long tails (~250 tokens) expect ~3 RPS/GPU at p95. If we hit 60% KV prefix cache hits, that effectively doubles throughput for chat requests. Plan: preheat top_7k prompts, session affinity, and monitor kv_hit_rate. Expect warmup token overhead ~1.5-2% of daily tokens.

priya_ops: Ops config snippet to include in proposal:
`model: rw-quant-70b-v3; reserved_gpus: 9; autoscale_min: 9; autoscale_max: 18; max_burst_gpus: 9; preheat_kv: true; warmup_targets: top_7k; az_strategy: 2-way; fallback_variant: rw-13b-quant`

rebecca_sec: Security checklist for their questionnaire: support for customer-managed KMS (yes); audit exports: we can stream inference metadata (request_id, model_version, timestamp, customer_id) to their SIEM; full payload logging requires contractual alignment (PII rules). Private control plane/VPC is available but adds 6-9 weeks onboarding.

jon_sales: Pricing ask: can we run a quick cost sketch comparing (A) 9 reserved + burst vs (B) 13 reserved + smaller burst? Include warmup token cost and show estimated effective per-token after commit discount.

priya_ops: Will run numbers. Ballpark: moving to 13 reserved will cut burst spend ~20-30% for similar peaks, but increases committed monthly spend. Effective per-token could improve ~15-22% depending on mix. I'll post a formal sketch by EOD.

marc_ml: I'll prepare a 1-page note on expected p95 delta with KV warmup (assumptions: kv_hit 50-70%, avg_seq 52, p95_seq 250) and include a suggested warmup cadence for daily patterns.

infra-bot: Reminder: schedule a 90m POC smoke test. Preheat 30m prior. Load profile: 30m baseline, 10m ramp, 20m peak at 500 qps, 20m soak, 10m cool-down. Embeddings at ~20% request mix. Attach load script when scheduled.

jon_sales: Action items: @priya_ops cost sketch for both options; @marc_ml 1-pager on KV warmup benefits; @rebecca_sec draft concise KMS/audit answers for questionnaire. I'll share both options with MercuryPay and propose two POC dates next week.

priya_ops: Acknowledged, posting numbers by EOD. :thumbsup:

marc_ml: On it, will include sensitivity ranges.

rebecca_sec: Drafting now, will include timeline for Private/KMS integration.

jon_sales: Thanks team, will update prospect once we have the sketches.
